claims.text: the tests catch every mutant of the code changed since main

mutants.command:
git diff "$FLOT_PROOFS_FROM" -- src > "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR/changes.diff" || exit 1
mutants=""
if [ -s "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR/changes.diff" ]; then
  mutants=$(cargo mutants --in-diff "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR/changes.diff" --exclude-re "tests::" --list) || exit 1
fi
if [ -n "$mutants" ]; then
  # Mutants build without debug info: about a seventh faster, the same
  # outcomes (118 mutants of a split of keying: 213 s, 184 s).
  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 cargo mutants --in-diff "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR/changes.diff" --exclude-re "tests::" -j 4 --timeout 300 -o "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR"
else
  # No change cargo-mutants can mutate, such as one only to text, for
  # which it writes no report: a report of no mutants.
  mkdir "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR/mutants.out"
  echo '{"schemaVersion": "1", "thresholds": {"high": 80, "low": 60}, "files": {}}' > "$FLOT_MUTANTS_DIR/mutants.out/outcomes.json"
fi
